description: What relates to one stored item, and what happened to it. ref: a Message-ID or message URL, a commit SHA or URL, a docs URL or page.html, a wiki URL or title, a commitfest URL, CVE-YYYY-NNNNN, or feature:<words> (matched to commitfest titles and to the subjects of the postgres commits that introduce it; ref.entries_used and ref.commits_used say which; a name nothing matches gives empty results, not an error). Returns related threads, commits (with releases and reverted_by), docs, wiki pages, commitfest entries and people, each with why, strongest first: explicit links, shared identifiers, then similar topic. For a postgres commit, thread, entry or feature, timeline says which release shipped it and whether it was reverted or back-patched: status plus dated events (first post, commitfest listings, commits with branch and first release, reverts), each with its source url. kinds narrows; limit_per_kind (default 5, max 25). ~3 s budget: late parts go in timed_out. For feature:<words> and commitfest entries, graph lists the stored design-history features (status, the one release it shipped in, decisions, positions), each fact with confidence, source and evidence; "probably" below 0.8, facts below 0.5 left out. Same as GET /api/v2/related.

ref.description: The item: e.g. 19705-548fda77321e062d@postgresql.org, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/brin.html, Don't Do This, b536d5a0bd7a, CVE-2024-10979, feature:incremental backup

version.description: Docs version for a page given without one (default current), e.g. 17

name: cross_reference
